data.name: Humeyra
data.gender_notes: Humeyra is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Name of the moon, symbolizing illumination and guidance. The name Humeyra carries the meaning “Moonlight” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Humeyra usually hope their child will grow to embody moonlight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the moon is a symbol of Allah's mercy and guidance.
data.etymology: Humeyra belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moonlight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Humeyra total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: حميرة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني الحمرة أو الأرض الحمراء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم حميرة هو اسم مؤنث عربي الأصل، يعني الحمرة أو الأرض الحمراء، وقد ورد في بعض المراجع أنه مشتق من الأرض الحمراء التي تسمى حميراء، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في بعض الأوقات كصفة للنساء ذوات البشرة الحمراء أو الشعور الأحمر، ويعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء الجميلة والخفيفة التي يفضلها الكثيرون في العالم العربي.

in_urdu.name: حمیرا
in_urdu.meaning: حمرا رنگ کی زمین یا سرخ رنگ
in_urdu.long_meaning: حمیرا ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو عرب سے تعلق رکھتا ہے، اس کا مطلب ہے حمرا رنگ کی زمین یا سرخ رنگ، یہ نام عرب دنیا میں بہت استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور اس کا تعلق سرخ رنگ یا زمین سے ہے، جو کسی قدرتی حسن کی تصویر کشی کرتا ہے، اور یہ اسلامی ثقافت میں ایک خوبصورت اور دلکش نام کے طور پر جانا جاتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: हमीरा
in_hindi.meaning: लाल रंग की ज़मीन या लालिमा
in_hindi.long_meaning: हमीरा एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, इसका अर्थ है लाल रंग की ज़मीन या लालिमा, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत पसंद किया जाता है, और यह नाम लड़कियों के लिए एक अच्छा विकल्प माना जाता है, क्योंकि यह नाम सुंदरता और खूबसूरती को दर्शाता है.

in_pashto.name: حميره
in_pashto.long_meaning: حميره د يوې ښځې نوم دی، چي د سورې رنګ يا سورخې ځمکې معنی لري، دا نوم د پښتو کلتور او ژبې سره تړاو لري، او د افغانستان او پښتونستان په سیمو کې ډیر کارول کیږي، دا نوم د ښځو لپاره د خوښۍ او ښکلاګانو د نښانې په توګه ګڼل کیږي.

in_english.name: Humeyra
in_english.long_meaning: Humeyra is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, meaning 'red soil' or 'reddish color', it is derived from the Arabic word 'humaira', which refers to the reddish-brown color of the soil, the name has been used in various Muslim cultures and is often associated with beauty, natural charm, and spiritual significance, reflecting the rich cultural heritage of the Arabic language.

data.cultural_impact: The name Humeyra has its origin in Turkish language, where it means "moon". It is a beautiful and popular name for girls in the Turkish and Islamic cultures. The name signifies the grace, beauty, and serenity of the moon. Humeyra is a common name in Turkey and many other Muslim countries, and it reflects the appreciation and reverence for the natural phenomena in Islamic and Turkish cultures.
data.spiritual_significance: The significance of the name Humeyra goes beyond its meaning as a symbol of the moon in the cultural context. In the Islamic tradition, the moon is a powerful symbol of divine guidance and illumination. The lunar cycles and phases remind Muslims of the constant presence and guidance of Allah (God) in their lives. The name Humeyra, therefore, carries a deep spiritual meaning as a reminder of the divine guidance and illumination that comes from Allah. It is a name full of hope, grace, and the promise of a better tomorrow, as the moon is a beacon of light in the night sky.
